newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end lower, Jan hits new contract low.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end lower, Jan hits new contract low.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled weaker, with most-active January falling to a life-of-contract low.
Analysts expect the market to continue its recent trend lower amid bearish technical indicators.
Bernard Savaiko, an analyst with PaineWebber, said open interest in January rose sharply in recent weeks, setting the contract up for a major price move.
He said the weekly chart shows a breakdown from a major head and shoulders top, and pegged support at 91.50 cents a lb.
January contract closed 1.50 lower at 94.85, traded 96.90 to 94.50, a life-of-contract low. The back months finished 1.45 and 1.30 weaker.
